title: Using ChatGPT to Teach and Learn English as a Foreign Language: Teachers' and Learners' Perspectives
core_idea: Explore teachers' and learners' perspectives on the use of AI tools, specifically ChatGPT, for teaching and learning English as a foreign language.
tldr: Mixed-methods study using closed- and open-ended questionnaires administered to 52 EFL teachers and 98 learners to examine their views on using ChatGPT in EFL instruction.
